data.name: 海洋時代-Ocean Age
data.description_full:
《海洋時代-Ocean Age》是一款聚焦15至18世紀地理大發現背景的全球海洋SLG手遊，專為喜愛航海冒險、策略對戰的玩家打造，核心亮點是無強制肝度、資源獲取輕鬆、公平競技無氪金壓力，支持港口貿易與寶藏探索，融合全球航行、迷霧探索、海戰交鋒、自動貿易等多元核心玩法，主打4X航海SLG與航海征服體驗，讓玩家沉浸式感受大航海時代的熱血與魅力，解鎖專屬航海傳奇。
【全球航行·迷霧探索】
遊戲擁有開放式全球地圖，覆蓋30國及300餘座港口，完美還原大航海時代風貌，支持港口經營。玩家可自由航行、探索迷霧寶藏，定期開放跨服競技，全程無閒置，每一次航行都有新收穫與挑戰。

【海戰交鋒·策略對決】
海戰是核心玩法，玩家可組建三線艦隊，搭配傳奇裝備與航海家技能調整戰術，主打航海征服體驗。遊戲內置20餘種歷史船隻、分13個等級，適配各類戰鬥場景，新手無操作門檻，輕鬆上手爭奪海洋霸權。

【傳奇航海家·技能傳承】
70+張金卡航海家分四大職業（海盜，海軍，賞金獵人，探險家），彙聚血腥瑪麗、哥倫布等知名人物。支持覺醒突破與技能繼承，閒置卡片可轉化戰力，為主力航海家定制專屬技能，培養輕鬆無壓力。

【貿易自由·碼頭築城】
遊戲擁有完善貿易體系，涵蓋30大品類、500餘種商品及貴金屬，支持AI命令艦隊自動貿易，無需手動操作即可低買高賣積累財富。玩家可自建碼頭、加入商會，協作爭奪資源，書寫航海傳奇。

【商會共贏·海洋霸權】
加入或創建商會可領取分紅、參與商會戰，貢獻突出可主導海域、指揮海戰。商會戰以資源島、城市爭奪為核心，考驗團隊協作，獲勝可獲稀有道具，助力提升戰力、爭奪海洋霸權。

data.name: Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
data.description_full:
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng là một trò chơi chiến lược quân sự trực tuyến độc đáo. Trò chơi mới này kết hợp chiến thuật quân sự, lối chơi casual và yếu tố mô phỏng, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn miễn phí và đầy kịch tính cho người hâm mộ game chiến tranh, RTS (Chiến lược thời gian thực) và chiến đấu quân sự.

Xây dựng Căn cứ
Trải nghiệm tính chân thực của chiến tranh hiện đại bằng cách xây dựng và nâng cấp các công sự quân sự, bao gồm tháp pháo phòng không, kho nhiên liệu và nhà máy thiết giáp. Tạo nên một pháo đài thép bất khả xâm phạm với sự cân bằng hoàn hảo giữa tấn công và phòng thủ. Quản lý chuỗi tài nguyên một cách chiến lược để tối đa hóa năng lực sản xuất chiến tranh, đảm bảo căn cứ của bạn sống sót sau những đợt pháo kích dữ dội trong các trận chiến thời gian thực.

Những Đội quân Huyền thoại
Chiêu mộ các vị tướng Thế chiến II huyền thoại như Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel và Zhukov, mỗi người sở hữu kỹ năng chiến thuật độc đáo và lộ trình nâng cấp cá nhân hóa. Kết hợp nhiều đơn vị quân đội - bộ binh, xe tăng, pháo binh và không quân - để tạo thành đội quân tối thượng có khả năng thống trị chiến trường trong cả chiến dịch PvP và PvE.

Chiến lược Chiến thuật
Một chỉ huy thực thụ giành chiến thắng với tổn thất tối thiểu. Những lựa chọn của bạn - lộ trình tấn công, thứ tự triển khai đơn vị và sử dụng kỹ năng chiến thuật thời gian thực - ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả trận chiến. Làm chủ chiến lược chiến trường, tham gia chiến đấu RTS căng thẳng và giành hết chiến thắng này đến chiến thắng khác trong cuộc chiến hành động nhịp độ nhanh.

Chiến tranh Liên minh
Bạn sẽ chọn chiến tranh hay hòa bình? Thành lập hoặc gia nhập một quân đoàn, mở rộng lãnh thổ và tham gia những trận chiến nhiều người chơi quy mô lớn toàn cầu. Phối hợp với đồng minh, nghiền nát căn cứ kẻ thù và chứng tỏ sự thống trị của bạn trong cuộc chiến chiến lược quân sự toàn cầu. Xây dựng liên minh, Đè bẹp áp bức!

Hình ảnh
Đồ họa tuyệt đẹp, được chăm chút tỉ mỉ, từ anh hùng, vũ khí cho đến phương tiện và trang bị. Mọi chi tiết đều tỏa sáng với màu sắc sống động và hiệu ứng ngoạn mục, khiến đây trở thành một trong những game chiến lược chiến tranh được thiết kế đẹp nhất thế giới.

「アヤカシ」と共に、人々の依頼を解決せよ――

繁華都市に潜む怪異事件。掲示板に書き込まれる不可解な謎。
そして、人知れず街を守る“アヤカシ”たち――。

あなたは「代行部」の一員として、個性豊かな“アヤカシ”たちと共に、
街で起きる怪異事件の調査と解決に手伝うことに。

不思議で賑やかな毎日の中で、
彼らと絆を深めていきましょう。

メインストーリーを豪華声優陣によるフルボイスでお届け！
Live2Dで生き生きと動くキャラクターたちが、
あなたをこの少し不思議な世界へ導きます。

■ストーリー
現代の東京――混乱と絶望に満ちた事件が次々と発生し、人々の心
には不安が広がっていた……。

そんな中、「∞ch」で広く知られる大手インターネット企業「森羅万象」
が動き出す。

新たに理事長に就任した青天目嵐牙は、社内に神秘の組織「代行部」
を設立した。

掲示板に書き込まれる怪しい事件の数々を解決する、特別な存在――。
だが、その正体は――彼らはすべて、“アヤカシ”である。

都市の秩序を守るため、正体不明の穢（けがれ）を排除するのを使命に、
彼らは今日も街の闇を駆ける。

あなたも「代行者」の一人として迎えられ、
そんなアヤカシたちと共に、どこかあたたかい日々を過ごしていく。

色々な事件の先で待っているのは、
誰かの孤独や、言葉にできなかった想いかもしれない。

これは、
人とアヤカシが紡ぐ、
優しくて少し不思議な物語。

本作は現代東京を舞台に、
個性豊かなアヤカシたちと怪異事件を解決していく都市非日常カードRPGです！

不思議な都市マップ、
戦略性のあるカードバトルを楽しめます！

アヤカシたちとの交流を通して、
彼らが抱える悩みや過去、
そして隠された想いに触れていきます。

笑って、悩んで、
時には胸が熱くなる――。

個性豊かな仲間たちとの物語を、
ぜひお楽しみください！

⸻

【POINT 2】Live2Dで楽しむ、あたたかくて、ちょっとドキドキする日常！

マイページ、ストーリーや好感度システムでは、
キャラクターたちがLive2Dで生き生きと動きます！

交流を深めることで、
ここだけの特別な会話や反応も……？

アヤカシたちとの、
賑やかでドキドキな毎日を楽しもう！

⸻

【POINT 3】カード育成で、アヤカシたちの新たな一面を解放！

アヤカシたちのさまざまな表情を描いた、
魅力あふれるカードを多数収録！

育成を進めることで、
カードイラストの変化や、
特別なストーリーも解放されます。

お気に入りのアヤカシたちとの絆を深めながら、
ここだけの特別な一面を見届けましょう♪

data.name: 雙面神姬
data.description_full:
【雙面神姬．正式上市】國民女神 林莎Lisa 傾情推薦！
✦ 登入即享1000次召喚獎勵
✦ 限定神明「媽祖」獨家登場
✦ 千年神明齊聚，神魔任你收集
神性無禁，隨心主宰，覺醒就在今日！

嘿，預言中的旅者！歡迎來到伊莫塔爾大陸。

雖然世界正被幽影侵蝕，但別擔心，拯救世界不必一個人硬扛！在《雙面神姬》，上百位東西方傳奇神明正等著與你簽下契約。

這裡沒有繁瑣的練功地獄，只有懂你、會陪你聊天的 AI靈魂伴侶。現在踏入大陸，我們準備了地區限定神姬、免費抽卡、粉鑽等超多福利 ，讓你出發即巔峰！轉動命運輪盤，這一次，你的傳奇由你做主。

神性自由，萬相顯化 —— 視覺與設定的雙重盛宴
厭倦了千篇一律的神明形象？在這裡，女媧、宙斯、媽祖、雅典娜皆擁有截然不同的「另一面」。性轉、黑化、成長前後的極致反差，每位神姬都提供至少兩種形態的獨立設定與華麗外觀。這不只是收集，更是探索神明隱秘真相的頂級美學之旅。

神力加持，天命逆轉 —— 執掌因果的終極博弈
命運輪盤與烏鴉信使隨侍左右。透過獨特的占卜系統，戰場局勢不再只是單純的數值輾壓。每一次轉動輪盤，都是對未知的獻祭，或是逆轉勝的奇蹟。在因果交織的迷霧中，你的直覺與抉擇，將成為改寫神界規則的唯一籌碼。

神域亂鬥，協力遠征 —— 東西傳說的巔峰對決
想像媽祖與宙斯並肩作戰的場景嗎？遊戲收錄上百位橫跨東西方文化的神祇，在史詩級遠征中，與公會夥伴協力挑戰強大首領。無論是東方的繾綣神韻，還是西方的殺伐之力，都將在你的指尖匯聚，組建跨越文明的夢幻戰隊。

AI神姬，真的懂你 —— 會聊天、會占卜、會變裝的「活」角色
她，絕不是冰冷的數據。內建AI智能交互系統，你可以與神姬實時對話，她會根據你的話題做出個性化回應。每日占卜揭示運勢。更驚喜的是，輸入提示詞就能讓神姬換上你理想中的裝扮，真正打造獨一無二、住在你手機裡的她。

神格共鳴，升級無壓 —— 全員共享的極致進化
徹底告別繁瑣枯燥的練等過程！只需精心培養你的核心小隊，透過「共鳴」系統，其餘所有神明都能同步共享等級與境界。抽到心儀的新神姬，一鍵繼承所有資源戰力，讓你在快節奏生活中，優雅享受純粹的養成樂趣。

data.name: ReTown
data.description_full:
In ReTown, every sunrise marks not just another day of survival, but a shift in the very foundation of the world around you. As the sun rises, the once-familiar terrain mutates—land masses tilt, new pathways emerge, and towering ridges rise from the ground, altering the battlefield and forcing you to rethink your every move. This isn’t just a fight against the undead—it’s a fight against the land itself.

At the heart of this chaos stands your Sacred Tree, a glowing monument of life in a rotting world. Its roots run deep, binding together the last fragments of nature’s magic. If it falls, so does all hope. Each night, waves of zombies swarm from every direction—shambling corpses, feral sprinters, armored abominations—each deadlier and more cunning than the last.

Survival isn’t just about swinging a weapon; it’s about adapting. Craft fortifications from scarce resources, place traps in shifting chokepoints, and upgrade your defenses to withstand the coming night. Your enemies will learn—they will climb, break, and swarm in new ways, testing every weak point in your strategy.

But danger also brings opportunity. As you explore the unstable terrain, you’ll uncover hidden resource caches, rare weapons, and ancient relics to empower your defenses. Every decision matters—do you risk venturing further for a powerful upgrade, or stay close to protect the tree?

The undead are relentless. The world is unpredictable. The only constant… is the fight.

現代の日本でオーベルジュ型のレストランを営むあなたは、

元の世界に戻る条件はただひとつ。

2.レストランで働くスタッフを配置
3.営業開始！料理の売れ行きやスタッフの働きを見守ろう
4.閉店、結果報告。結果を元に明日のお店の営業内容を考えよう

あなたは彼らと心を通わすことができるのか！？

data.description_full:
【Oyuna Genel Bakış】
Sıradan bir lise öğrencisi, bir gün aniden ortaya çıkan "Öte Dünya İstilası" olayının ortasında kalır. Çaresizliğin eşiğindeki bu genç, kendi ruhsal enerjisini kontrol etme yeteneğini uyandırır ve saldırıdan kıl payı kurtulmayı başarır.

Ertesi gün, kendilerine "İttifak" diyen bir örgütün ajanı çıkagelir. Ajanın anlattıklarına göre bu dünya, öte dünyadan gelen "İntikamcı Ruhlar"ın tehdidi altındadır; ruhsal enerji yeteneğine sahip "Özel Güç Kullanıcıları" ise gölgelerin ardında onlara karşı savaşmaktadır.

Ajanın rehberliğinde lise öğrencisi, özel yeteneklileri eğiten "Ruhsal Enerji Akademisi"ne transfer olur. Ancak onu bekleyen şey; her biri kendine has kişiliklere sahip yoldaşlarıyla birlikte yapacağı zorlu antrenmanlar ve insanlığın varoluşunu tehdit eden güçlü ruhsal felaketlere karşı verilecek bir ölüm kalım savaşıdır.

【Öne Çıkan Özellikler】
▶ Benzersiz Güçlerini Uyandır, Kendi Kaderini Çiz

Her bir savaşçının kendine özgü yetenek sisteminin kilidini açıp derinlemesine geliştirin. Strateji ve bilgelikle dolu bu karakter geliştirme yolculuğunda, savaşçılarınızın savaş alanında fark yaratmasını sağlayın.

▶ Rüya Takımını Kur, Zafer İçin Savaş

Kendine has özelliklere sahip efsanevi savaşçıları toplayıp akıllıca eşleştirin. En güçlü 3 kişilik savaş kadronuzu kurarak, takım ruhunun savaş alanında ışıldamasına tanıklık edin.

▶ Akıcı Gerçek Zamanlı Savaşlar, Görkemli Kombolar

Heyecan dolu gerçek zamanlı savaşlarda yeteneklerinizi doğru zamanlamayla serbest bırakın. Göz kamaştırıcı kombolar yapın ve takım arkadaşlarınızla kusursuz bir uyum içinde güçlü düşmanları alt edin.

▶ Bölge Patronlarına Meydan Oku, Kahramanlığını Kanıtla

Arkadaşlarınızla omuz omuza savaşın veya çevrimiçi arenalarda kozlarınızı paylaşın. Güçlü bölge liderlerine meydan okuyarak gücünüzü kanıtlayın ve kendi efsanenizi yazın.

【Bize Katılın ve Bu Gizemli Maceraya Atılın】
Yeni bir tehdit sessizce yaklaşıyor, dünya kurtarılmayı bekliyor. Oyunu hemen indir ve özel güçlerle dolu macera dolu yolculuğuna başla! En güncel haberlerden anında haberdar olmak ve size özel ödülleri kaçırmamak için resmi topluluk sayfalarımızı takip edin!

data.name: Number Clear - Match Master
data.description_full:
Game Introduction
✨ Looking for a way to unwind while keeping your mind sharp? Number Clear is the perfect number logic game for you. It features simple, intuitive rules, yet every elimination move is packed with strategic fun.
☕ Whether you’re killing time during your commute or seeking a peaceful space to think after a busy day, Number Clear delivers the purest, most refreshing puzzle experience. Challenge yourself, beat your high score, and enjoy the ultimate sense of relief as numbers vanish from the board one by one!
How to Play
🎯 Objective: Clear all number tiles from the board and aim for a perfect full clear!
🔢 Matching: Find pairs of identical numbers (e.g., 5 and 5) or numbers that add up to 10 (e.g., 3 and 7).
⚡ Elimination: Connect two numbers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally as long as there are no obstacles between them.
➕ Progression: When no more moves are available, tap the button at the bottom to add extra rows of remaining numbers and use your wits to find new opportunities in the number grid.
Game Features
🚀 Epic Power-Ups: Stuck on a puzzle? Use the Sledgehammer to break a single obstacle, or activate the Logic Tornado to reshuffle the board and unlock brand-new possibilities.
🎨 Minimalist Design: Free from clutter. A clean UI paired with soothing sound effects helps you focus purely on logic and slip quickly into a deep “flow state.”
🏆 Daily Challenges: Fresh, unique puzzles every day. Complete objectives to collect exclusive trophies and make your mark on the global leaderboard.
📡 Play Offline: Fully supports offline mode. Enjoy a quick mental workout anytime, whether on the subway or a plane.
🧘 Stress-Free Experience: No time limits, no forced countdowns — solve puzzles at your own pace and savor the fun.
Pro Player Winning Strategies
💡 Think Globally: Don’t just focus on adjacent numbers! Watch the connections between the end of one row and the start of the next — high-scoring matches often hide there.
💡 Priority Rule: Prioritize combinations that block pathways to free up space for large-scale eliminations later.
💡 Item Management: Earn coins through chain eliminations and use power-ups strategically in key levels to maintain your win streak.
🌈 If you love Sudoku, crossword puzzles, 2048, or number merge games, Number Clear is the perfect choice for you!
🔥 Ready to clear the board? Download Number Clear now and start your number-matching journey — every elimination brings a rush of accomplishment!
data.description_short: The ultimate relaxing brain-training journey in Number Clear!

data.name: DD3Nurb Patch
data.description_full: DD3Nurb Patch is a fast-paced endless arcade game that puts your reflexes and focus to the test. Tiles scroll continuously down 4 columns — tap only the black tiles to earn +1 point each, and steer clear of white tiles entirely. • Tap another screw to drop it onto a nut of the same color.

The rules are simple, but the puzzles get cleverly tricky. There are no timers and no pressure: just smooth, satisfying, relaxing color sort gameplay you can enjoy at your own pace.

Every stage is a brand-new color sorting challenge that puts your logic, focus and forward planning to the test.

• 🧠 Brain training: sharpen your logic, memory, focus and problem-solving skills with every sort.
• 🎨 ASMR satisfaction: oddly satisfying clicks, metallic clinks and buttery-smooth animations.

Sort by color, match the nuts, untangle the mess, and feel that oddly satisfying click as each bolt snaps perfectly into place. Take a deep breath, sort the colorful nuts and bolts, and watch a busy, messy board turn calm and tidy.

Whether you’re a fan of color sort puzzles, screw jam games, ball sort, water sort, hoop stacks or wooden nuts & bolts challenges, Nuts Match: Sort Puzzle brings a fresh, modern and adorable twist you simply won’t be able to put down. The concept is refreshingly simple. Each arrow points toward an exit direction, but only arrows with an unobstructed path can move. Your objective is to remove every arrow from the puzzle by selecting them in the correct order.

What begins as a straightforward challenge quickly evolves into a rewarding test of logic and spatial awareness. Every arrow influences the puzzle around it. Some moves create opportunities, while others may block future progress. Understanding these relationships is the key to mastering the game.

Arrow Frenzy: Tap Out Puzzle delivers a satisfying gameplay loop built around observation, prediction, and strategy. Players constantly evaluate possible moves, search for hidden solutions, and experience rewarding moments when a clever sequence unlocks the entire board.

Unlike many puzzle games that depend on matching colors or collecting items, Arrow Frenzy focuses entirely on logical movement and strategic thinking. The result is a clean, focused puzzle experience that remains engaging from the first level to the last.

The game's minimalist presentation enhances the challenge by removing unnecessary distractions. Every element serves a purpose, allowing players to concentrate fully on solving puzzles and improving their skills.

As you advance through the game, levels become increasingly creative and complex. New layouts require deeper analysis, better planning, and stronger problem-solving abilities. Each completed puzzle feels like a genuine accomplishment.

Arrow Frenzy is perfect for players who enjoy:

• Logic puzzles
• Brain training games
• Spatial reasoning challenges
• Strategy puzzles
• Minimalist puzzle experiences
• Relaxing problem-solving gameplay

The flexible gameplay allows you to enjoy quick sessions throughout the day or settle in for extended puzzle-solving marathons. Every level offers a fresh challenge and a new opportunity to sharpen your thinking skills.

Key Features:

• Addictive tap-out puzzle mechanics
• Strategic arrow-clearing gameplay
• Satisfying chain reactions and unlocks
• Hundreds of handcrafted logic levels
• Brain-training challenges for all skill levels
• Minimalist visuals and intuitive controls

Arrow Frenzy: Tap Out Puzzle is more than a simple puzzle game. It is a journey of logic, observation, and discovery where every move brings you closer to the perfect solution.

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

Trò chơi sử dụng công nghệ engine 3D, tái hiện không khí sân đấu sống động; thao tác mượt mà, phản hồi chính xác từng thao tác chạm, giúp bạn linh hoạt điều khiển cầu thủ và rê bóng dễ dàng. Hơn 100 cầu thủ hàng đầu được góp mặt, cho phép tự do chiêu mộ và xây dựng đội hình siêu sao mạnh nhất! Ngoài ra còn có hệ thống Bồi dưỡng cầu thủ phong phú, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn mới, giúp bạn tạo nên siêu sao của riêng mình!
- Siêu sao Nguyễn Văn Toàn bất ngờ gia nhập, chỉ từ 3.000 VNĐ là có thể mở khóa SSR Nguyễn Văn Toàn!
- Đăng nhập nhận ngay cầu thủ SSR đỉnh cao, khung avatar giới hạn và gói quà vật phẩm siêu giá trị!
- Khai mở nhận ngay 1000 lượt quay, thỏa sức chiêu mộ từ kho cầu thủ khổng lồ! Huyền thoại sân cỏ, siêu sao đương đại đều có thể sở hữu dễ dàng, xây dựng đội hình All-Star trong mơ mà không cần bất kỳ điều kiện nào!

[Thao tác sân đấu chân thực]
Hệ thống điều khiển chạm - kéo sáng tạo, cho phép bạn trực tiếp điều khiển siêu sao!
Từ những pha qua người kỹ thuật, xoay người Marseille, đến vô-lê sấm sét hay bứt tốc đối mặt thủ môn, mọi kỹ năng khó đều có thể thực hiện dễ dàng bằng đầu ngón tay. Mỗi đường chuyền, mỗi cú sút đều do bạn kiểm soát, mang lại cảm giác kịch tính và bùng nổ!

[Xây dựng đội bóng siêu sao hàng đầu]
Bạn chính là người điều hành duy nhất của CLB!
Hơn hàng trăm huyền thoại và siêu sao đương đại được tái hiện, cho phép tự do ký hợp đồng và xây dựng Dream Team. Hệ thống Sảnh Danh Vọng, đội ngũ cố vấn HLV chuyên nghiệp hỗ trợ bồi dưỡng toàn diện cầu thủ, giúp bạn tạo dựng đế chế bóng đá và viết nên huyền thoại riêng!

[Chiến thuật đỉnh cao, linh hoạt bố trí]
Trở thành bậc thầy chiến thuật và làm chủ mọi trận đấu!
Các sơ đồ phổ biến như 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1, 5-3-2 có thể tùy ý kết hợp. Tính năng thay người và thay đổi chiến thuật theo thời gian thực giúp bạn linh hoạt ứng phó với đối thủ. Kết hợp kỹ năng và liên kết đội hình để tạo nên những pha phối hợp hoàn hảo, xuyên thủng hàng phòng ngự kiên cố!

[Đấu Online nhiều người]
Đối đầu trực tiếp với người chơi thật trên toàn quốc!
Từ giải đấu đến sân đấu thế giới, vượt qua mọi thử thách và tiến vào trận chung kết để giành cúp vô địch. Chinh phục đỉnh cao sân cỏ và chứng minh bạn là huyền thoại thực sự!

Tải ngay , tạo ra huyền thoại bóng đá của riêng bạn trên sân cỏ này!

Pull back from the ball, release to launch, and aim for the next safe pad. Collect coins, charge stronger shots with magnet boosts, avoid spike platforms, and touch crown rings to trigger automatic jackpot bounce chains.

CORE FEATURES

DRAG-TO-LAUNCH CONTROL
Pull back, aim the arc, and release with direct touch control.

SAFE PAD CLIMBING
Land cleanly on vault pads to keep the run alive and build score.

REWARD PICKUPS
Coins add bonus points, while magnet boosts charge a stronger next shot.

CROWN JACKPOT CHAINS
Touch a crown ring to activate automatic multi-hop jackpot movement.

HAZARD PRESSURE
Spike platforms end the run when the ball lands on them, so every shot needs timing and aim.

CLEAR SESSION FLOW
Start from a focused home screen, read icon-based rules, pause anytime, restart quickly, and review each result.

LOCAL BEST SCORE SAVE
Your best score is stored on the device so every run can push the record higher.

data.name: Everything in Place
data.description_full:
Welcome to Everything in Place.The world has lost its color. Objects are scattered, scenes are grey, and everything feels incomplete. In Everything in Place, it's up to you to pick up the pieces, place them back where they belong — and watch the world come alive again, one object at a time.
What Makes Everything in Place Special:
- A Puzzle Game With a Twist Most puzzle games ask you to match, swap, or sort. Everything in Place asks you to rebuild. Each level presents a colorless 3D scene, and your job is simple in concept but deeply satisfying in practice: figure out where each displaced object belongs, and place it back. Get it right, and color floods back in instantly. Piece by piece, a lifeless grey scene transforms into something warm, vibrant, and alive. There's nothing quite like watching a world come back together under your hands.
- A World Worth Exploring Every scene is fully three-dimensional, and that changes everything. Spin it around, tilt it, peek behind objects — because things aren't always where you'd expect them to be. Before you place a single object, take a moment to explore the space, learn its layout, and let the scene reveal its secrets. Every level feels like stepping into a tiny, handcrafted world with its own personality — and the more you look, the more you find.
- Grows With You Early levels ease you in gently, giving you a feel for how things fit together. As you progress, scenes become richer, more detailed, and more layered — with more objects to place and more clever spots to uncover. New levels are added regularly too, so there's always a fresh world waiting to be rebuilt.
- Play Without Pressure There are no timers ticking away in the background. Take your time, rotate the scene, soak in the details, and enjoy the meditative process of putting everything back in its place. Everything in Place is designed to fit around your life — pick it up when you want, put it down when you need to.
- Tools to Keep You Going Stuck on a particularly tricky object? A handful of in-game tools are there to give you a nudge without spoiling the fun. Think of them as a helpful hint — just enough to keep you moving, without taking away the joy of figuring it out yourself.
Everything in Place is for you if:
- You love puzzle games but hate the stress of timed challenges.
- You find deep satisfaction in rebuilding something piece by piece and watching it come together.
- You're drawn to cozy, beautifully crafted little worlds full of charm and detail.
- You want a game that feels calming on the surface but keeps your mind quietly engaged.
Download Everything in Place Today! Every grey scene is a world waiting to be rebuilt. Every object has a place. And every time you get it right, the colors come rushing back. Start placing, start restoring — your world is waiting.

data.name: Arrow quest:Lucky Reward
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward — a gentle puzzle journey where every arrow has somewhere to go.

On each board, arrows point in different directions. Some look left, some look right, others up or down. Your task is simple but thoughtful: release each arrow the way it faces, and watch it slide off the board. No dragging. No rotating. Just pure, careful decision-making.

But there's a quiet challenge beneath the calm surface. If two arrows cross paths and touch, your run loses one chance. You begin every level with three tries. Let them collide too many times, and you'll need to start over.

This is not a game about speed. It's about seeing the board clearly before making a move. Which arrow should go first? Which one is trapped until another leaves? Step by step, the puzzle unfolds like a gentle riddle.

The visuals are soft and clean. The sounds are light and rewarding. Each solved level brings a small sense of progress — like finishing a page in a favorite book.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Arrow Quest fits quietly into your day. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a little bit of luck.

Can you guide every arrow home without a single mistake? Download Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward and begin your journey today.

data.description_full:

■『イナズマイレブン クロス』とは 

レベルファイブが贈る「イナズマイレブン」シリーズの新作がスマートフォンに登場！
新たな主人公が繰り広げるオリジナルストーリー！

自分だけのドリームチームを育成し、試合に挑もう！

日本代表イナズマジャパンは、大型クルーズ船『イナズマビッグフェリー』に乗り、
全世界が注目する少年サッカーの祭典
『フットボールフロンティア・インターナショナル（ＦＦＩ）』を勝ち進んでいた。
しかし、大会中に監督が突然の退任を発表する。
次の監督に指名されたのは、チームの補佐をしていた主人公・汐沢(しおさわ) 陽(よう)だった。
いきなりの監督任命に戸惑いながらも、陽は戦術分析能力を活かし、
キャプテンの円堂守や選手たちと力を合わせて、世界の頂点に立つ。

ところが、突如発生した謎の地震で意識を失い、
目覚めた時には、円堂たちの記憶から陽の存在だけが消えていた。
さらに、仲間だったエースストライカー豪炎寺修也と、ゲームメイカー鬼道有人が
帝国学園の姿で敵として現れ、冷たい視線で勝負を挑んでくるのだった。

記憶の消失、改変された関係、変わってしまった世界──
すべての真相を求め、陽は未知なる未来へと進み始める。

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?
data.description_short: Slide & match arrows to solve brain-teasing puzzles! Simple rules, endless fun!

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Sort: Mahjong tile sort puzzle. Plan, categorize, relax & train brain.

data.name: CrisisX
data.description_full:
A deadly mysterious virus outbreak wiped out most of the population within a few days, and the unknown infection continues to spread. People fled in chaos into the streets, only to realize that their homes had transformed into a post-apocalyptic wasteland, with toxic mutants and zombies roaming the city. Infrastructure is destroyed, and society and civilization have completely collapsed. Families were separated when fleeing into the wilderness.
Now, in this devastating doomsday, you are on your own! "SURVIVE" is the only thing that matters. How much longer can you make it out there?
CrisisX MAX. Your ultimate survival experience.

▶ The world is yours to discover! ◀
Embark on your unknown adventure by creating a realistic self-avatar and exploring every inch of a unique, wide-open world with one of the largest maps ever developed. Raid cities, bunkers, and other locations teeming with terrifying walking dead, or explore freezing cold forests in the highlands. The game mechanics restore realistic geographic and climate conditions in North America, enabling you to experience different environments, landscapes, weather, and time zones. Confront numerous unexpected and serious tasks in a life after the end of the world, and build yourself a last shelter in this fallen continent!

▶ New order & rules must be established! ◀
Survival of the fittest! Test your survival skills by finding food and water, and collecting essential but rare materials left from the civilized world. Scavenge resources through activities like cutting trees, mining, hunting, gathering, and fishing to gain enough leverage for surviving the last days and perhaps establishing yourself as the most powerful among the last survivors. After all, only the strongest will endure in the light of day!

▶ Knives out, fight or fight! ◀
Exterminate crowds of mutated zombies and shoot down threatening monsters of all kinds. Each infected individual has a different appearance and attacking pattern depending on its mutation routes. As the last survivor, observe and employ a wise strategy to eliminate and escape the state of decay!
Your most formidable enemies are other surviving human players! Do not blindly venture into the dead; instead, grip your weapon tightly, be vigilant, and keep your eyes open for other survivalists passing by, whether engaging in a 1vs1 battle or an alliance battle. The distinction between a loyal friend and a dangerous intruder is often a fine line.

▶ Together, we thrive! ◀
Gain a foothold first by constructing yourself a shelter and exploiting resources through activities like taming horses, building, planting, and breeding. Ally with other survivors, restore a community, and expand in this zombie apocalypse. Fight side by side with your fellow survivors to resist enemy attacks. Only together can we survive in the last days on Earth!

▶ Uncover the mystery behind the end of the world! ◀
On this action packed journey of survival, you’ll be facing different tasks, puzzles and riddles. Solve them to expose the truth of the shattered world and save the dying light of the civilization. Perhaps the destruction of the fallen humanity was not an accident! You may also find more clues to trace your family’s whereabouts!
CRISIS X is YOUR LAST CHANCE OF SURVIVAL!

PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.

data.name: Animal Link
data.description_full:
Welcome to Animal Link, a charming match‑2 puzzle game for animal lovers! Your goal: find two identical animal tiles – like lions, pandas, elephants, or penguins – and connect them with a line that bends no more than twice. The path between them must be completely free of any other tiles.

As you advance, the board grows larger and new animals appear, testing your observation and memory. Each level is timed, so think fast and plan your moves carefully.

Need help? Use special boosters:

Shuffle – rearranges all remaining tiles.

Hint – highlights a valid matching pair.

Claw – removes any single tile.

With hundreds of adorable levels, vibrant wildlife art, and relaxing background music, Animal Link offers endless fun for all ages. Play offline anytime – no Wi‑Fi needed.

Download now and start linking your favorite animals!

data.description_full:

誰說稱王一定要累得半死？別人要肝要農，你只需要動動手指，輕輕鬆鬆就能創造骨王傳奇。
登入直接送 10,000 抽，骨碌骨碌隨便抽，每個骨頭都是最強「骨力軍團」

【養骨有妙招：豪禮狂送，助力稱王】
上線即享豪禮狂歡，寶箱遍地開，英靈隨手招，資源輕鬆爆滿倉。自動掛機征戰不打烊，戰力猛猛漲、骷髏不忙碌、不費力亦能稱王。

【召喚有巧思：佛系抽卡，萬骨可養】
全圖鑒收集講究緣分，緣分到來誰也擋不住。抽卡無需繁瑣儀式，不用焚香沐浴、不看時辰風水，指尖輕輕一劃，英靈自動排隊前來歸順。滿倉只是起步，養到會進化才是真正本領！

【變強有捷徑：花式進化，成就骨王】
還在苦研複雜進化路線？我們的養成邏輯簡單直接。輕鬆培養即可快速變強，一路橫掃對手毫無壓力。每隻骷髏都能花式「進化」—— 從灰撲撲小骨頭變成青熒到發光骷髏王，外型與實力雙重飛升，進化之路永無止境～

【陣容有講究：自由搭配，陣陣都強】
他人絞盡腦汁研究陣容，我們的小骷髏只有隨心所欲。戰力擔當、輸出核心、防禦大將隨意組合，流派套路自由切換，無需死抄作業，不被固定玩法束縛。輕鬆搭配即可橫掃戰場，你的戰術你做主，魔界任你馳騁！

【稱王有坦途：從骨到王，輕鬆無壓】
開局只是一隻無人在意的小骷髏，全程佛系養成、花式進化、隨心搭配。輕輕鬆鬆晉升魔界戰神。讓整個魔界都知道 —— 輕鬆是態度，養成才是王道！

data.name: Тоwеr Rush
data.description_full:
Тоwеr Rush is a high-pressure arcade survival game where reaction speed and precision decide the fate of a collapsing tower. A crack begins at the base and relentlessly climbs upward, threatening to destroy everything in its path. Your role is to hold the structure together by reacting instantly to weak points before the damage spreads too far.

The challenge is built around constant escalation. Each successful repair buys you precious time, while mistakes make the situation worse by accelerating the crack’s advance. As the run continues, the pace intensifies: weak points appear faster, sometimes in multiple places at once, and the crack becomes less predictable as it changes direction. Staying focused is critical, as hesitation or misjudgment can quickly turn control into chaos.

Тоwеr Rush delivers short, intense sessions where every second matters. There are no distractions or side mechanics — only pressure, timing, and endurance. Victory comes from holding the tower intact until the round ends, while defeat arrives the moment the crack reaches the top. It’s a pure test of nerves, reflexes, and the ability to stay sharp when everything is breaking apart.
data.description_short: Stop the crack, save the tower, and survive the rising pressure.

data.name: Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle
data.description_full:
Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle invites you to a serene world where traditional tile matching meets the breathtaking beauty of real-world natural landscapes. This experience is thoughtfully designed for players who value a quiet, focused environment and a visual escape into nature. Whether you are a seasoned enthusiast or seeking a peaceful retreat, you will find a respectful and calming journey here.

Respectful Design for Senior Players 👵
Large Tiles - The game features large, high-contrast mahjong tiles that are easy to identify. This eye-friendly approach ensures you can play for extended periods while maintaining visual comfort.
Nature-Inspired Layout - Our clean interface is designed to complement our stunning natural backgrounds. By focusing on an organized layout, we provide a strain-free experience that lets you concentrate on the joy of the puzzle.
No Pressure - There are no countdown timers or high-pressure mechanics. You are free to think, plan, and move at your own speed in this gentle zen environment.

Daily Brain Training and Mental Wellness 🧠
Daily Mental Stimulation - Solving these tile matching puzzles encourages pattern recognition, memory retention, and strategic thinking. It serves as an excellent daily exercise for the mind.
Balanced Challenge - The difficulty curve is carefully designed to provide a sense of achievement and progress without becoming overwhelming.
Focus and Clarity - Taking a few moments for a mahjong session each day helps maintain mental sharpness and provides a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

A Pure and Reliable Experience 🌿
Play Offline Anywhere - No internet connection is required to access the full game. You can enjoy your journey during your quiet hours at home or while traveling without worrying about data or WiFi.
Real Natural Scenery - Every level features vibrant, high-quality photography of real nature. From tranquil forests to majestic mountains, the background shifts to keep your experience fresh and meditative. Straightforward Mechanics - This is a pure triple match experience. We focus on the core mechanics of the game, providing a stable and dependable app for your leisure time.

How to Play 🎮
Match Three - Tap three identical mahjong tiles to move them to the collection bar and clear them from the board.
Complete the Puzzle - Successfully remove all tiles from the screen to reveal the full beauty of the landscape and advance to the next level.
Strategic Slots - Manage your collection bar wisely to ensure you always have space for your next move as you work toward clearing the board.

Find your peace of mind and rediscover the simple joy of tile matching with Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle!

Sniper Shooter Safari Hunter provides smooth gameplay performance with optimized controls for an enjoyable hunting experience. data.name: Alphabet Merge!
data.description_full:
Alphabet Merge! - The Ultimate Real-Time Word Puzzle
Get ready to test your reflexes and expand your vocabulary! Alphabet Merge! is a highly engaging, strategic word-building puzzle game where fast-paced arcade action meets rigorous brain training.

Manage a continuous cascade of falling alphabet blocks within a 6x10 grid. As letters plummet from the top, you must think fast and make rapid decisions to prevent the board from overflowing. Do you have what it takes to survive the drop?

🎮 How to Play
Physically interact with the grid by sliding your finger across adjacent or diagonal letters to connect sequences. Build meaningful words to clear the board, score points, and stay alive!

✨ Key Features
👉 Intuitive Swipe Controls
Freely connect letters in any direction—up, down, left, right, and diagonally! Just swipe to construct your words.

🧠 Real-Time Dictionary Validation
Powered by a sophisticated built-in English dictionary backend, every sequence you form is evaluated instantly. Experience seamless, lag-free gameplay as the game confirms your words on the fly.

💥 Satisfying Merge Mechanics
When a valid word is formed, the connected letter blocks gracefully merge and clear out of the grid, rewarding you with a satisfying visual effect and a boost to your score.

🌪️ Gravity-Driven Combos
Clearing words is just the beginning! Once blocks disappear, suspended letters physically drop down due to gravity. This dynamically reshapes the board, creating thrilling chain reactions and massive combo opportunities!

🏆 Reflexes Meet Strategy
It's not just about knowing words; it's about finding them under pressure. Perfect your quick decision-making skills and push your vocabulary to the absolute limit.

data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. Không cần hiến tế tài nguyên, không cần đổi chác vận may - càng tu luyện, càng được ưu đãi, để pháp lực thăng hoa và quyền năng ngày một lớn mạnh.

累計発行部数3000万部、全世界で爆発的な人気を誇るファンタジー小説「龍族」が群像劇RPGで登場！
AIアシスタント搭載、魅力的なキャラで爽快バトル、新たなIFルートで運命を廻せ！

▼没入感の高いストーリーとIFストーリー
世界中で大人気の原作小説を元に構築した300万文字を超える濃厚なストーリー。
豪華声優陣の熱演によりさまざまな名場面や名台詞を再現。
本作だけのオリジナルIFルートを多数実装し、全キャラとデートも可能に！
原作では描かれなかった未知なる可能性を、あなたの手で体験しよう！

▼今なら最大400連分無料ガチャ！ログインだけで全キャラ解放のチャンス！
キャラクターの収集ハードルは低めに設定！
ログインボーナスでは、恒常・限定を問わず多くのキャラクターが入手可能！
イベント報酬も充実！ 魅力的なキャラを仲間に迎え絆を深めよう！

▼セミオート王道RPG×策略×爽快バトル
キャラクターの編成や絆の発動など、あなたの戦略次第でバトルはより楽しく奥深く変化する！
オートプレイモードもあるので、カジュアルにも楽しめる！
キャラクターごとにバトル中の専用演出もあるので、爽快感UP！
策略を駆使して、言霊を放て！

▼デイリーミッションはAIにお任せ！
ゲーム内にはAI助手“ノルマ”を実装。
ボタンひとつで面倒なデイリーミッションなどをAIがオールクリア。キャラ育成も超簡単。
より快適に、より自由に、ストレスフリーで『ドラガク』を楽しめる！

▼世界を広げる豊富なイベントとコンテンツ
バトルやメインストーリー以外にも、数多くのミニゲームやサブストーリーを実装！
月毎にイベントも実装し、さまざまな角度から『ドラガク』の世界をディープに遊びつくそう！

▼豪華なサウンドと演出
テーマ曲《IVORY TOWER》はさまざまなアニメやドラマのサウンドを手掛ける澤野弘之氏が担当。
さらに美麗なキャラクター、迫力あるCG演出、Live2Dによる繊細な動きが、新たな『龍族』の世界へあなたを導きます！
豪華声優陣が続々出演（五十音順）
石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

▼ストーリー
遥か昔、この星は【黒の龍王】ニードホッグを創造した。
そして【黒の龍王】は、【白の龍王】をはじめとするすべての竜の始祖となった。
【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。
その後、【黒の龍王】は四大君主と呼ばれる4対の龍王を創造し、【白の龍王】は人間との間に多くの混血種たちを残した。
世界は竜族を中心に廻っているかのように見えたが……
ある日、【黒の龍王】が暗殺されたことで世界は一変した。
これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.name: betPawa
data.description_full:
Goal Master League is a football club management experience built around a unique tactical free kick duel. Instead of a generic arcade match, the game puts you in the role of a professional coach who must read moving defenders, judge shot power, and bend the ball past a reactive goalkeeper to win each match.

The core gameplay is a custom-built penalty-style challenge where every shot depends on direction, timing, and curve. Defenders shift in live patterns, the keeper tracks your strike, and difficulty levels change the pressure from rookie training to legendary match conditions. Each session is a short best-of-five duel designed to feel strategic rather than repetitive.

Beyond the pitch, Goal Master League gives you a complete club environment. Review a full squad with position ratings and player stats, study football knowledge in a curated coach library, track career records and achievements, customize your club identity, and adjust gameplay settings to match your style.

Goal Master League stands out by combining club management presentation with an original skill-based shooting game that rewards precision, awareness, and smart decision making. It is simple to pick up, deep enough to master, and built as a complete football experience from kickoff to championship ambition.
data.description_short: Goal Master League is a football club management experience

data.name: Clack - Keyboard ASMR
data.description_full:
A one-handed keycap clicker. Collect keycaps with blue, red, and brown switch ASMR sounds.

Clack, clack, clack.
The smallest keycap collection game for keyboard lovers.


Every tap might drop a keycap

Press a keycap with your finger and once in a while, very rarely, a small keycap falls.
From common to rare, hero, and legendary. The moment a rare one drops, the screen sparkles and full-screen confetti bursts.


Real mechanical switch ASMR

Switch freely between three switch sounds: blue, red, and brown.
Put on your headphones, take a break, and lose yourself in the clicks.


Dex and collection

Every keycap you obtain is recorded in your dex automatically.
See a locked preview of what is out there, and unlock each one by obtaining it yourself.
Pull the same keycap again and your collection count stacks up.


Customize, make your own keycap

Common keycaps let you freely change their color and engraving to make them your own.
Hero and legendary keycaps keep their unique signature design.


Keycap fusion

Gather several keycaps of the same grade and aim for a higher grade.
The more you put in, the higher your success chance, and what comes out is up to luck.


Survival mode

Test your reflexes and chase your best score.
How many points can you rack up before time runs out?


Time attack mode

Show off the fastest fingers around.
Shave down your record and push your limits.


Keyboard settings

Switch sound, LED color, click effect, effect color, and more.
Bubble, heart, sparkle, petal, and other effects plus LED moods to make the keyboard your own.


Achievements

From a thousand taps to your first legendary find.
Twenty achievements are waiting for you.


Who is this for

- Keyboard and keycap lovers
- Fans of ASMR and collection games
- Anyone looking for a light game for the commute
- Anyone who misses the joy of rapid clicking


Privacy

Your game progress is stored on your device by default.
Only when you use the ranking and friends features is your score synced to the server anonymously, with no sign-up required.

Drop rates: https://keycap.gajami.app/probability
Contact: contact@gajami.app

data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

data.name: Crowd Bus Jam
data.description_full:
🚌 Match the Passengers, Fill the Buses! 🚌

Your mission: get every waiting passenger onto the right bus. Sounds simple? Wait until you see the crowd. The platform can hold up to 64 passengers at once — and they keep coming in batches of 12.

🎨 Match by Color
Each passenger has a color. Each bus also has a color. A red passenger can only board a red bus. No exceptions. You’ll need to keep an eye on the platform and match colors carefully.

🚍 8 Seats per Bus
Every bus fits exactly 8 passengers. That means you can’t just throw random people on board. You have to fill each bus completely with the right color before it leaves.

🧠 Plan Your Platform
Passengers arrive in batches of 12. If you don’t match them quickly, the platform fills up. Once it hits 64, no more passengers can arrive — and if there’s no space for the next batch… game over. You’ll need to balance which buses to call and which colors to prioritize.

🌈 More Colors, More Chaos
As you level up, more colors appear. Passengers come in trickier patterns. The platform gets crowded fast. You’ll need quick decisions and a sharp memory to keep everything moving.

🏆 Can You Clear the Platform?
The goal is simple: get every passenger on a bus before the platform overflows. No timer, but every batch adds pressure. One wrong bus choice and you might block yourself for good.

Ready to become the ultimate dispatch master? Match those colors, fill those buses, and clear the queue! 🚦🔴🔵🟡🟢🚌
data.description_short: Make sure all passengers board the bus that matches the color!

data.name: Merge Parade
data.description_full:
■ Build Your Army on a 5×5 Grid.

Merge Parade is a formation-based auto-battler set on a 5×5 grid. Buy monsters, merge them into stronger evolutions, and arrange them in a winning layout using powerful adjacency passives. Combat plays out automatically — your only job is deciding who stands where. One smart placement can turn the tide.

■ Core Gameplay Loop

- Buy monsters from the shop
- Place them on your 5×5 grid
- Merge neighboring units to evolve them
- Watch the auto-battle play out
- Use the gold you earn to build an even stronger army for the next fight

Battles end fast — about a minute at normal speed, just 20 seconds at top speed. Perfect for a quick session, addictive enough to lose hours in.

■ From a Tiny Slime to a Mighty Dragon

Goblins, slimes, plants, undead, demons, elementals, dragons, constructs, beasts — nine cute monster tribes to recruit and combine. Follow recipes to merge them, and watch small units evolve into towering powerhouses. Chain a few humble slimes all the way up to a colossal dragon lord and feel the army truly grow.

■ Formation Is Everything

Every unit comes with passives that depend on where you place it: "boost the attack of adjacent allies," "shine alone in a corner," "weaken nearby enemies," and many more. Columns also build up stacks of burn, slow, and shield as the fight unfolds. Push a stack high enough and a Surge erupts — a powerful burst that can flip the whole battle.

Stacking strong units isn't enough. Who stands next to whom, and which column they hold, decides the fight.

■ One Run, Fifteen Battles. Try Again, Try Smarter.

A roguelite structure with lives. Beat all 15 battles to clear a run. Lose a fight but keep your lives, and you can retry. Lose your last life, and the run ends.

Even a defeat teaches you something — new unit knowledge, new recipes discovered, new matchups understood. Every run sharpens your strategy for the next. Once you've conquered the basics, take on the tougher difficulty modes waiting for you. If you've got the skill, the challenge is ready.

■ A Small Goblin with Big Dreams

Meet Gobsby — a small-town goblin with grand ambitions. Beside him is Nick, a chatty little mimic-book, narrating his journey. With only a handful of monster friends at his side, Gobsby sets out for the distant Demon Lord's castle.

Recruit allies. Crush rivals. Watch your tiny gang grow into a marching army — a long, eccentric parade across the world. Cute, a little clumsy, but impossible not to root for. Their story is waiting for you to play it.

■ Perfect For Players Who Love

- Auto-battlers and idle-style action
- Puzzle-strategy and tactical placement
- Collecting, merging, and leveling up
- Quick sessions that fit any pocket of time
- Charming monster designs

■ Free to Play

* Optional in-app purchases / Contains ads

Take command. Set your formation. March your army to victory.
data.description_short: 5×5 grid auto-battler. Merge monsters, build your army, conquer the run.

data.name: Game Is Hard
data.description_full:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels and hard puzzle challenges, creating a unique hard puzzle game experience.

Every puzzle breaks the rules, no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence in a truly engaging hard puzzle game.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable, until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you. It rewards those who think differently, the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want, perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

Features:
• Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
• Challenging hard puzzle mechanics and unique level design
• Hints are available, but never obvious
• Works fully offline, great for no wifi games and free play
• Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
• Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
• Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
• No scores or timers, just pure gameplay

data.name: Tower Rush
data.description_full:
Aim for the clouds and test your architectural precision in Tower Rush, the ultimate arcade stacking challenge. Set against a beautiful urban skyline, your mission is to construct a magnificent skyscraper by carefully balancing unique home modules on top of one another. Each level brings a new beautifully designed floor, from cozy cottage-style rooms to elegant modern apartments, all swinging from a heavy-duty crane above your foundation. The secret to success lies in your timing; one tap drops the current floor, but only a perfectly aligned landing will keep your structure stable as it reaches higher into the blue.

The gameplay is a pure test of rhythm and focus that rewards a steady hand. As you successfully attach more homes to your rising tower, the momentum of the swinging crane becomes more challenging to predict, turning every new floor into a high-stakes balancing act. If your alignment is off, the tower will begin to wobble, eventually leading to a dramatic collapse that signals the end of your construction project. The goal is to see just how many floors you can stack before the laws of physics take over, pushing your previous high scores to new limits with every attempt.

Tower Rush features a vibrant and detailed art style that makes every building look like a handcrafted masterpiece. The intuitive one-button controls make it easy for anyone to pick up and play, while the increasing speed and shifting weight of the blocks provide a deep challenge for masters of the genre. Monitor your score in real-time, keep an eye on your personal best, and strive to create the most impressive residential tower the city has ever seen. It is time to start building, find your rhythm, and show the world that you have what it takes to reach the top.

data.name: Arrow Puzzle 3D - Arrows Out
data.description_full:
Arrow Puzzle 3D is a puzzle game that teases your brain as you tap arrows in the right order to clear a 3D board. Find free paths, open more space with every move, and watch each shape open up as the puzzle unfolds. The added depth of the 3D layouts makes every level mentally engaging, rewarding careful observation, smart planning, and satisfying solutions.

Why you'll love Arrow Puzzle 3D:

• Relaxing gameplay

Arrow Puzzle 3D combines calm visuals with clever challenges that are easy to follow and rewarding to solve. Every board feels clear and readable while still pushing you to think ahead.

• Simple controls, satisfying flow

Tap arrows when their path is free and clear the board piece by piece. The controls are easy to learn, making offline tap games smooth, accessible, and satisfying from the very first level.

• Smart puzzle challenge

As new obstacles appear and layouts become more complex, each puzzle asks for more careful planning. Every move changes the board, creating fresh arrow out situations and new ways to progress.

How to play:

• Study the 3D board and see where each arrow points.

• Tap arrows only when nothing blocks their movement.

• Remove pieces in the right order to create more space.

• Clear the full shape to solve each arrow puzzle game.

• Use hints when stuck and enjoy the smooth tap away gameplay.

How to master the arrow game:

data.name: Word Solitaire Go
data.description_full:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

data.name: Arrow Rush 3D
data.description_full:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲

data.name: Untangle Ropes
data.description_full:
Untangle Ropes is a captivating physics puzzle game that puts your logic and spatial thinking to the test. Untangle messy knots, sort jumbled ropes, and move each loose end to its proper place. Every drag feels satisfyingly real, with ropes that twist, overlap, and snap into position just like the real thing. Whether you're looking for a mental workout or a calming brain break, this game delivers the simple joy of bringing order to chaos—one rope at a time.
Gameplay Overview
Each level presents a tangled layout of ropes pinned to a board. Your goal is simple: drag the loose ends and place them in the correct spots to straighten everything out before time runs out. But watch out—ropes can cross, loop, and wind around obstacles, creating tricky Knots that demand careful planning. The game uses a realistic physics engine, so ropes glide and resist with natural weight. Every second counts, adding just the right amount of challenge to each Puzzle. As you progress, you'll encounter fixed anchors, multi-point ropes, and uniquely shaped connectors that bring fresh layers of Logic and Match-based fun.
Key Features
- Realistic Physics Puzzle: Ropes bend, wrap, and interact with lifelike tension. Every drag feels tactile, making each solution deeply satisfying.
- Simple One-Touch Controls: Just pick a rope end and slide it to the target spot. Easy to learn, yet packed with brain-teasing logic challenges.

data.name: JigTown - Puzzle
data.description_full:
I. Core Gameplay​
Drag and rotate puzzle pieces to align them, restore high-definition images, unlock levels and achievements. A relaxing, stress-relieving, and brain-training experience.​
II. 3 Game Modes at a Glance​
Classic Puzzle: Regular rectangular pieces with grid layout, beginner-friendly. Start by assembling the frame, then fill in the middle.​
Fragment Reassembly: Irregular polygonal pieces, intermediate difficulty. Match textures and shapes—adjacent pieces can be highlighted for assistance.​
Special-Shaped Puzzle: 3D interlocking pieces (with protrusions and indentations), hard difficulty. Find the interlocking points and align them precisely to lock in place.​
III. Basic Controls (Super Simple)​
Long-press to drag pieces; double-tap to rotate.​
Pinch to zoom in/out for overall view or detailed checks.​
Progress auto-saves—resume gameplay anytime after exiting.

data.name: Arrows Dash
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrows Dash! A sleek yet captivating logic puzzle game that blends strategic thinking with soothing gameplay. It is designed to sharpen your mind while offering a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. More than just a casual pastime, Arrows Dash delivers a thoughtfully crafted gaming experience. Every move matters, every decision tests your foresight, and every puzzle solved brings a deeply satisfying sense of accomplishment. Whether you are a seasoned puzzle enthusiast in search of new challenges or a casual player looking for a relaxing way to keep your mind active, Arrows Dash invites you to dive into a world of minimalist design, ingenious mechanics, and endless logical fun.

Yet do not be fooled by its straightforward appearance. What starts out as an effortless task will soon evolve into a true strategic challenge. A single misstep can trap your arrows, forcing you to rethink your approach and plan every move with precision. Unlike fast-paced action games that demand quick reflexes, this game features a stress-free, timer-free design. Play at your own pace, experiment with different strategies, and savor the calming journey of solving each puzzle.
Our team has poured passion into crafting over 3,000 meticulously designed levels. Each stage is tailored to challenge your logical reasoning, spatial awareness and critical thinking without overwhelming pressure. The game boasts a smooth, intuitive difficulty curve: begin with basic grids featuring only a single arrow to clear, then gradually progress to intricate layouts filled with multi-directional arrows, tricky pathways and cleverly placed obstacles that push your strategic skills to the limit. Every level is entirely unique — no random generation, no repetitive patterns — ensuring every puzzle feels fresh, fair and rewarding. As you advance to higher difficulties, you will navigate expansive grids that stretch beyond a single screen. Drag to explore the full map, adding extra depth and dimension to your puzzle-solving adventure.

data.name: Vita Mahjong Wood
data.description_full:
Vita Mahjong Wood: Classic Wooden Tile Matching, Your Exclusive Relaxing Puzzle Game!
Vita Mahjong Wood is an exclusive classic wooden tile matching puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this mahjong game that combines innovation with classic gameplay. It features warm, wooden large tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with pads and phones. Our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging gaming experience, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Mahjong Wood:
Playing the free Vita Mahjong Wood game is simple. Just aim to clear all the tiles on the board by matching tiles with identical images. Tap or slide two matching wooden tiles, and they will vanish from the board. Your objective is to match tiles that are not concealed or blocked. Once all tiles are eliminated, it signifies successful completion of a mahjong game!
Exclusive Vita Mahjong Wood Game Features:
- Classic Wooden Mahjong Experience: Staying true to the original gameplay, it presents traditional wood-grained tile sets and hundreds of boards, offering you the purest classic feel.
- Special Innovations: Besides the classic, our game introduces special tiles that add a fresh twist to traditional mahjong.
- Large-Scale Design: Our mahjong games feature large, easily readable text sizes on comfortable wooden tile surfaces to alleviate the strain caused by small fonts.
- Active Mind Levels: A special mode designed to sharpen your mind and improve memory abilities in the mahjong games.
- Customizable Scoring: You can enjoy free classic mahjong games without a timer and any score pressure.
- Super Combo: When you consecutively match mahjong tiles during the game, you will unlock special experiences.
- Helpful Hints: Our game provides free useful props, such as hints, undo, and shuffle, to help players overcome challenging puzzles.
- Daily Challenge: Take on daily practice to collect trophies and improve your classic mahjong solitaire game skills.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you enjoy Vita Mahjong Wood anytime, anywhere, without needing internet.
- Multi-device: Optimized for pad and phone, ensuring everyone can enjoy this classic mahjong game.
Vita Mahjong Wood is a versatile game made for those who love tile matching games. Download Vita Mahjong Wood and immerse yourself in the serenity and joy of classic wooden mahjong, starting your mahjong dynasty now!
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong Solitaire. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong or other types of solitaire or card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Mahjong Wood: Classic Wooden Tile Matching: Relaxing Offline Puzzle Games!

data.name: Arrows Go: Arrow Escape Puzzle
data.description_full:
Go Arrows Go is a fun and relaxing puzzle game that keeps your brain engaged without feeling stressful.

In Relaxed mode, your goal is simple: find the arrow that can move out freely, tap it away, and open space for the next one. As the board fills up, every move matters more, and the wrong tap can cost a heart, so a little planning goes a long way. Want tougher untimed solves? Jump into Challenge mode with the same hearts-and-hints flow as Relaxed, but with harder grids organized into themed city packs. Use pinch-to-zoom + pan on the biggest layouts so you can scan the board comfortably.

Want more intensity? Jump into Timed mode and race the clock. Pick a collection (grid size), solve a random board as fast as you can, and climb daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards. Your final time includes mistake penalties, so speed and accuracy both count.

Whether you want a quick mental break or a competitive challenge, Go Arrows Go is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. The clean minimalist design, smooth controls, rewarding logic gameplay, in‑app Guide, and Collection replay make it a great fit for players who enjoy clever arrow/path puzzles across calm, collectible, and competitive play styles.

How it works:
• Look for an arrow with a clear path to the board edge
• Tap arrows in the right order to open new routes
• Avoid blocked taps as mistakes cost hearts in Relaxed and Challenge (+ refill options when you’re out of hearts)
• Use hints when you need a little help (they trace a safe move and escape path)
• Clear every arrow to finish the level

Challenge mode spotlight:
• Harder grids in city collections, still untimed with hearts + hints
• Pinch + pan for comfortable navigation on very large puzzles

Timed mode highlights:

data.description_full:
[عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق —— الملحمة الخيالية الأكثر واقعية]
"بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر، وبالإرادة نعيد تشكيل العالم"
في عصر يسوده الظلام، أنت وحدك من يحمل نصل الحق، لتحطم القيود وتُخلِّد أسطورتك!

انغمس في عالم MMORPG أسطوري. من تخصيص الأبطال المهيبين إلى معارك الحصار الملحمية، "عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق" ليست مجرد لعبة، بل هي رحلة لإعادة صياغة مصيرك في عالم مليء بالعجائب.

—— نظام الفئات المتطور ——
من الظلال إلى السيادة: اختر طريقك من بين فئات قتالية صُممت بدقة فائقة. سواء اخترت مهارات "المغتال" المتخفي أو بأس المحارب الجبار، ستُحس بقوة إرادتك وهي تُحوِّل بطلك من محارب في الظلام إلى أسطورة تقود الميدان وتغير موازين القوى.

—— فخامة التصميم والجماليات الواقعية ——
أناقة الفرسان الأوفياء: ارتدِ دروعاً وأزياءً أسطورية تعكس هيبة أبطال عالمنا وفخامتهم. نحن نؤمن بأن "الحقيقة" تكمن في التفاصيل؛ لذا قمنا بتصميم أجنحة متلألئة وخيول أسطورية بمعايير جمالية عالية، تمنحك مظهراً مهيباً يفرض احترامه في كل ركن من أركان الممالك التسعة.

—— القتال، العتاد والسيطرة ——
أطفئ نيران الحرب بيدك: تحدَّ زعماء العالم في معارك طاحنة لانتزاع أندر الأسلحة والدروع. كل قطعة عتاد تحصل عليها هي خطوة نحو "إعادة تشكيل العالم". سيطر على ساحات PvP وأثبت أن إرادتك هي القوة الأسمى التي لا يمكن قهرها.

—— نمو ذكي وتطور تلقائي ——
حرر يديك واستمتع بالحرية: لأن وقت البطل ثمين، وفرنا لك نظام قتال تلقائي متقدم يتيح لك رفع مستواك وجمع الموارد بمنتهى السلاسة. حتى وأنت بعيد، يظل بطلك ينمو ويقوى، لتكون دائماً مستعداً لإطفاء نيران الأزمات التي تهدد العصر.

—— تحالفات قوية وروابط اجتماعية ——
قوة الجماعة في نصل واحد: أنشئ "عشيرة" قوية وانخرط في حروب حصار ملحمية مع إخوة السلاح. بفضل نظام التواصل الصوتي المتطور والميزات الاجتماعية العميقة، ستجد من يشاركونك الإرادة لتصنعوا معاً مجد المستقبل في هذا العالم الأسطوري.

—— أهم مميزات اللعبة ——
جوهر الأسطورة: "بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر" - قصة عميقة مستوحاة من أساطير الفايكنج الخالدة.
إرادة التغيير: "وبالإرادة نعيد تشكيل العالم" - نظام تطوير شخصيات حر ومتعدد الأبعاد.
محتوى محلي حصري: أزياء وفعاليات صُممت خصيصاً لتلائم أذواق أبطالنا وتُجسِّد هيبتهم.
عالم مفتوح واقعي: رسومات من الجيل التالي تجعل من كل مشهد لوحة فنية سينمائية.
نمو ذكي وسلس: نظام آلي يضمن لك التقدم السريع والمريح في أي وقت وأي مكان.

هل أنت مستعد لتشكيل العالم بإرادتك؟

data.name: Tower Jump Rush
data.description_full:
Tower Jump Rush features a structure-building gameplay where players stack house blocks layer by layer to create a stable tower. The core experience focuses on timing, alignment, and maintaining balance as the structure grows taller.

Blocks move horizontally across the screen, and players must release them at the right moment to place each floor accurately. Perfect alignment keeps the tower stable, while misplacement trims the structure and increases difficulty for the next layer.

As the tower rises, movement speed increases and placement precision becomes more critical. Smaller surfaces and faster motion require consistent control and quick reactions to maintain progress.

The gameplay centers on continuous stacking, where each decision affects the stability of the entire structure. Players aim to build higher towers while managing narrowing space and increasing pace.

Players earn in-game currency through successful construction, which can be used to unlock different building styles, visual themes, and gameplay variations.

This game does not include any real money or any opportunities to win real money or real-world rewards. It is purely a simulation game where players earn and use virtual currency only.
